# Provenance

- Source: project-original synthetic orthogonal polygon model, fixed `2026-10-26-polygon-overlay-v0.1.2`; v0.1.1 adds nested-ring boundary tests and corrects topology classification without changing the public rules.
- License: project public release license pending owner decision; no external maps or task data copied.
- Adaptation: no external benchmark conversion. Harbor directory layout follows the existing local project convention.
- Capabilities: even-odd ring fill, group Boolean overlay, source attribution, exact unit-edge metrics, 4-neighbor components and partition audit.
- Natural parallelism: geometry and metric interfaces can be developed separately, but coverage/selection/components have dependencies; classify as an irregular integration opportunity, not broad simultaneous Agent execution. Cell count is data volume, not Agent work nodes. No forced DAG.
- Network/resources: offline logic, Python standard library, 2 CPU, 2 GiB, no GPU. `allow_internet=true` by explicit user authorization for new66–100 formal tasks and free oracle copies; business logic remains offline.
- Contamination: computational geometry is generic; randomized synthetic rings, IDs, holes and contacts discourage memorization. No external or private evaluation data copied.
- Verifier: independent ray-cast/flood-fill reference, fixed and runtime varied structure, no-op and targeted mutants, input immutability and output stability.
adaptation: All contracts, examples, and solvers for this revision are project-authored.
